onset_f1_definition: mir_eval 0.8.2 onset.f_measure: maximum bipartite matching (Hopcroft-Karp), inclusive window |ref-est|<=tol, tol in {0.05, 0.02} s, reference = unedited official chart (shifted with the notes under the joint time-origin control); cross-checked against scipy maximum_bipartite_matching on every record

label_rules.DETECTS: frozen rule SURVIVES (both 99.5% upper bounds < 0 in the worse direction, controls pass, >=72 songs)
label_rules.BLIND: every seed at every strength equals the unedited chart's value exactly
label_rules.REWARDS: a 99.5% lower bound > 0, i.e. moves toward the conventionally better value (lower perplexity; higher self-similarity -- only if higher is read as better, which is ambiguous)
label_rules.N/A-by-design: time-only metric (IOI-JS, onset F1) under a type-only edit (C3, C4, C5); exactly unchanged by construction, not an empirical failure
